disclaimer: Scholarships are awarded by governments and universities — not by SK Immigration. Deadlines, quotas and eligibility change. Always apply on the official portal. SK can help you understand fit and prepare supporting documents.

scholarships.name: DAAD scholarships
scholarships.deadlineNote: Most development-related masters: annual autumn window — verify daad.de
scholarships.forPakistanis: Yes — many programmes list Pakistan as eligible. Competition is high.
scholarships.eligibility: Usually a bachelor, 2+ years’ work for EPOS, German or English as the programme requires.
scholarships.fit: Best for strong academics heading to Germany. Not a shortcut around blocked-account study files.

scholarships.name: Deutschlandstipendium
scholarships.deadlineNote: Set by each university after you enrol
scholarships.forPakistanis: International students at participating unis can apply.
scholarships.eligibility: Merit + social criteria. You usually need an admission first.
scholarships.fit: A top-up, not full funding. Still budget the blocked account.

scholarships.name: Stipendium Hungaricum
scholarships.deadlineNote: Usually Nov–Jan for the next academic year — verify stipendiumhungaricum.hu
scholarships.forPakistanis: Pakistan has a bilateral quota. Nomination via the Pakistani sending authority.
scholarships.eligibility: Academic record, medical, programme match. Age and field rules apply.
scholarships.fit: The main full-ride Europe option Pakistanis actually win. Self-funded Hungary is a different file.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.forPakistanis: Yes. Leadership essays matter as much as GPA.
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate degree, 2+ years’ work, returnable to home country.
scholarships.fit: Not for fresh graduates with no work story. SK can review essays; we cannot lobby the FCDO.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
scholarships.deadlineNote: Annual — via nominating agency in Pakistan
scholarships.forPakistanis: Yes, through the Pakistani nominating agency.
scholarships.fit: Research and development themes beat generic MBA pitches.

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.deadlineNote: Most programmes: Oct–Jan — verify the course page
scholarships.forPakistanis: Yes. Partner-country students are a core target.
scholarships.eligibility: Bachelor + programme-specific GPA/language. You apply to the consortium, not to SK.
scholarships.fit: Excellent if your field matches a listed joint master. Mobility across 2+ countries.

scholarships.name: Türkiye Bursları
scholarships.amount: Tuition + stipend + housing + language year (typical package)
scholarships.eligibility: Age caps, GPA floors, interview. Do not mix with a paid-agent ‘guaranteed bursary’.
scholarships.fit: Apply only on the official portal. SK can sense-check documents, not submit for you unofficially.

scholarships.name: Italy DSU / right-to-study grant
scholarships.forPakistanis: International students can apply if the ISEE-equivalent file is complete.
scholarships.eligibility: Family income documents, translations, regional portal. Not automatic with admission.
scholarships.fit: Plan a self-funded backup. DSU is real but paperwork-heavy.

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships
scholarships.amount: Stipend towards living (tuition still often due) — verify HEA
scholarships.eligibility: Offer from an Irish HEI first.
scholarships.fit: Partial. Ireland files still need strong funds evidence.

scholarships.name: Holland Scholarship / Orange Tulip
scholarships.amount: Often €5,000 first year (Holland) — Orange Tulip varies
scholarships.eligibility: Non-EEA + admission. Does not cover full living + tuition.
scholarships.fit: A discount, not a full ride. Dutch files remain expensive.

scholarships.name: NAWA / Polish government scholarships
scholarships.forPakistanis: Some programmes include Pakistan; others are EU-only — read the call.
scholarships.fit: Most Pakistani Poland files are still self-funded with possible university discounts.

scholarships.name: Fulbright / USEFP (Pakistan)
scholarships.forPakistanis: Yes — Pakistani citizens via USEFP only.
scholarships.eligibility: Academics + GRE where required + return pledge.
scholarships.fit: Do not use visit-visa or fake-agent channels for US study funding.

scholarships.name: Australia Awards
scholarships.amount: Full package for development fields (country programme)
scholarships.forPakistanis: When Pakistan is listed in that year’s programme.
scholarships.eligibility: Development impact + return. Not a generic student visa discount.
scholarships.fit: Separate from a self-funded Australian GS file.

scholarships.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
scholarships.amount: CAD 50,000 / year for 3 years (typical published rate — verify)
scholarships.forPakistanis: International PhD nominees can be considered.
scholarships.eligibility: Research excellence. You need a Canadian supervisor/university.
scholarships.fit: Not for diplomas or PGWP shopping.

scholarships.name: Malaysian Technical Cooperation Programme (MTCP)
scholarships.amount: Gov-to-gov / nominated — not a walk-in student discount
scholarships.deadlineNote: Via Pakistani government channels when open
scholarships.forPakistanis: When nominated. Ordinary self-funded Malaysia study is different.
scholarships.fit: Do not pay an agent who ‘sells MTCP seats’.

scholarships.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Monthly allowance (tuition often still billed) — verify Campus France
scholarships.deadlineNote: Campus France / institution nomination in autumn
scholarships.forPakistanis: Via the French HEI — you cannot apply as an individual on a random form.
scholarships.fit: Campus France procedure still sits on top of the visa file.
